subject: Private hosting — ops handshake, open networking questions & next steps
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clinex.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@clinex.com>, Clinex IT Procurement <procurement@clinex.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting — quick recap from today's call

Irene — thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Quick recap from our side so we don't miss anything: 

- Primary driver: PHI data residency and auditor requirement to demonstrate complete network isolation for analytics workloads.
- Must be deployed in our existing VPC (AWS us-west-2) with no public egress for inference.
- We need documented answers on: peering vs. Transit Gateway approach, allowed outbound ports, and whether Redwoods' control plane requires an open outbound management channel (and what IPs/ports).
- Procurement asked for a sample MSA clause for on-prem / private deployment and a brief SLT summary for our security review.

Next steps from Clinex: procurement will share the security questionnaire (SOC2 + network diagrams) by EOD tomorrow. Our infra lead (Alyssa) will send a VPC CIDR and existing peering topology.

Attachments: I attached the high level compliance checklist we run internally.

Thanks — Samir
Sr. Director, Platform, Clinex Health
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clinex.com>
Cc: Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@clinex.com>, Clinex IT Procurement <procurement@clinex.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting — quick recap from today's call

Samir — appreciate the clear summary. I pulled together the things we discussed and added the immediate asks/owners below. Attaching a rough VPC sketch and our ops checklist (placeholders where we need Clinex details).

Key confirmations from Redwood:
- We support private deployment into customer VPCs (us-west-2) without public egress for inference nodes.
- Control plane: optional split-control model — we can run a limited managed control plane (over TLS) or a fully air-gapped control plane. For the fully air-gapped option we provide an on-site bundle and install instructions; it requires a maintenance window for upgrades.
- Networking options: Direct VPC Peering (simple, but transitive routing gaps) or Transit Gateway (recommended for scale). We prefer Transit Gateway when customers have multiple VPCs or need centralized routing/policies.

Open/Action items (owners):
1) Clinex to share VPC CIDR(s), peering/TGW setup, and egress policy (Alyssa) — due Thu 08/26.
2) Redwood to provide: sample MSA clause for private deployment + high-level SLT one-pager (Irene) — due Wed 08/25.
3) Redwood infra to confirm control-plane IPs/ports and exact outbound requirements for managed-control option (Ben) — due Fri 08/27.
4) Both teams to set a 30-minute follow-up with Clinex infra to walk the VPC sketch (Irene / Alyssa) — propose Mon 08/30.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-network-sketch.pdf (sketch), rdw-hosting-ops-checklist.xlsx (ops checklist).

I will loop in Jordan to start drafting the MSA snippet and security one-pager. If you have a preferred template for the MSA, please send it over and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private hosting — quick recap from today's call

Irene — quick tech notes for the infra team while we wait for Clinex details. Forwarding Samir's msg.

Top-level engineering clarifications we'll need to answer for Ben/Infra deck: 
- Control-plane managed option: outbound-only TLS to a fixed set of IPs — we'll publish the CIDR and port list. For maintenance windows we can allow a temporary SSH jumpbox for support (customer controlled).
- Air-gapped option: we provide an install tarball + verification script; no outbound required but upgrades are manual.
- Peering specifics: if Clinex wants strict isolation, Transit Gateway w/ enforceable route tables + no route propagation to shared/public subnets is the safest.
- Egress: we'll support a NAT gateway pattern if they need model artifact download; for fully offline inference we can pre-stage artifacts on an S3 endpoint behind the VPC.

I'll own the outbound IP/ports doc and the install bundle checklist. Suggest we use the shared Drive link in Irene's email and add the infra checklist there.

-Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clinex.com>
Cc: Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@clinex.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Clinex IT Procurement <procurement@clinex.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting — ops handshake, proposed timeline and meeting invite

Samir / Alyssa — thanks again for the call and for sending the compliance checklist. Per our internal notes we've prepared the following proposed timeline and deliverables: 

Week of 08/23
- Tue 08/24: Redwood sends sample MSA clause + SLT one-pager (attached: clinex-sample-ma.json).
- Thu 08/26: Clinex shares CIDRs and peering/TGW topology.

Week of 08/30
- Mon 08/30: 30-min infra walkthrough (proposed: 10:00 PT) — meeting invite sent separately.
- Tue 08/31: Redwood infra publishes outbound IP/ports table + install bundle checklist to shared Drive.

Blockers identified:
- Decision needed from Clinex security: managed-control-plane (requires outbound TLS) vs fully air-gapped (manual upgrades). This decision affects procurement timeline.
- For air-gapped installs we need a designated maintenance window and access policy for on-site engineers (if customer requests Redwood-assisted installs).

Ask for procurement: if Clinex has a preferred MSA template or redlines, please share them so Jordan can draft a first pass (Jordan will lead contract coordination).

I've attached the sketch and the draft MSA snippet. Next: I will create the follow-up calendar invite for Mon 08/30 and Ben will share the outbound IP list by Tue EOD.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: clinex-sample-ma.json (MSA snippet), redwood-vpc-network-sketch.pdf, rdw-hosting-ops-checklist.xlsx
